shared_elements: relief carving of what appear to be anthropomorphic figures
justification: Both surfaces appear to depict anthropomorphic figures in relief, with what may be heads and a hand discernible in A, matching the very generic level of a human-like figure with a head, arm and hand in B; beyond that nothing specific is shared. B shows a single tall, fully articulated winged figure in strict profile with beard, feathered wing, fringed garment and held attributes, arranged as one dominant standing figure filling the panel, whereas A shows several small, lumpy, bulbous rounded forms crowded together with no wings, costume, attributes or profile convention, and the manner of rendering (massive rounded volumes versus fine incised linear detail) is entirely different.
